title: Operator hello
description: First message from an operator interface when its WebSocket opens, carrying its operator_id and key; the key appears in no other message. Core checks the key like an asset key (it stores only the hash). Each interface has its own operator_id: if a second link opens with the same operator_id, the newer link replaces the older and Core closes the older. Core answers admin.hello_reply with operator_id, then pushes every Asset's latest admin.hello and latest reports, then forwards new reports live. No user accounts or roles.
